summary: Bank of N.T. Butterfield & Son Ltd (the Company) filed a Form 6-K to report entry into a share purchase agreement with CIBC on May 27, 2026, to acquire CIBC's 91.67% stake in CIBC Caribbean Bank Limited. Consideration is a mix of 11,577,367 ordinary shares (exchange ratio 0.008008 per CIBC Caribbean share) plus cash of US$0.6918 per share—aggregate cash $1.091 billion. The board recommends the deal; no advisor named. A mandatory take-over bid for the remaining 8.33% minority at equivalent terms follows. Conditions include shareholder approval, regulatory consents, and NYSE listing. Watch minority take-up and regulatory timeline in Caribbean jurisdictions.
